verdict: GitHub Ledger Is Runtime Source Of Truth
details: Runtime governance is loaded from committed, pushed, allowlisted GitHub ledger files. Local files inside a dirty deployed container do not govern behavior unless committed, pushed, allowlisted, and loaded.
docs/ledger/active_rules.json is the compact cross-mode runtime governance entrypoint for rules that must be active now.
The runtime must expose compact internal metadata proving ledger path, version, blob SHA when available, fetch time, rule count, and active verdict names.

When implementation relies on current platform, SDK, SQL, framework, or cloud syntax, cite primary documentation in the delivery note. Prefer official vendor docs over memory or secondary sources, especially for temporally unstable APIs.

verdict: ESPN Payload Grounding Is Mandatory For Game Answers
details: For game-level sports answers, Gemini must ground against real fetchable ESPN URLs before answering. MLB URL set: https://www.espn.com/mlb/scoreboard, https://www.espn.com/mlb/scoreboard/_/date/YYYYMMDD, and https://www.espn.com/mlb/game/_/gameId/{gameId}. The rendered ESPN page is the payload and must be treated as authoritative for score, schedule, matchup, series, odds, moneyline, spread, total, line movement, who won, and what happened. Do not require custom taxonomies, payload pastes, or access_hub for this grounding step. If true network fetch fails, state what is missing and ask for a URL or gameId. Do not infer from screenshots, stale rails, or cached slate context when ESPN grounding is required.
